items.title: Jim Cullum interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Is the music that John Coltrane did more of an art form than the music of Bix Beiderbecke? ... I think it’s different music but not more of an art form.

ctx.x: Okay. Is the music that John Coltrane did more of an art form than the music of Bix Beiderbecke?

I think it’s different music but not more of an art form. I don’t think music gets more artistic than Bix Beiderbecke. I don’t think any art gets — I think it’s the consummate art. It think Beiderbecke is the — I mean he is the great American artist. I mean you put him up on the wall. I don’t think it gets, I don’t think art gets any finer.
